description: List known Socrata-powered government open-data portals with their domain, organization name, and approximate dataset count. The catalog is a curated list of 39 well-known portals; dataset counts are fetched from the Discovery API and cached for ~24 hours. Filtering is client-side substring match on the query parameter. Use this first when you do not know which portal to target, then pass the domain to socrata_find_datasets.

query.description: Keyword to filter portal names or organization names (case-insensitive substring match). Omit to list all portals.

name: socrata_list_portals

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Recovery hint when no portals matched the filter. Absent on non-empty pages.

portals.description: Matching portals. Empty when no results.

dataset_count.description: Approximate count of dataset-type assets on this portal from the Discovery API catalog (point-in-time, refreshed ~daily). 0 means the portal exposes no dataset assets to the catalog; null means the live count is temporarily unavailable.

domain.description: Portal domain (e.g. data.seattle.gov). Pass to socrata_find_datasets.

organization.description: Organization name when available (e.g. City of Seattle).

totalCount.description: Total portals before pagination. 0 when empty.

title: List Socrata Portals
